Ravi M: Quick sync — launch week plan for benchmark + webinar. Need final X/LinkedIn schedule, tone tests, influencer outreach list, and lead routing details. Can we freeze assets by EOD Tue?
Tess L: Yep. I'm prepping 2 tone directions: "technical" (focus on methodology + numbers) and "product" (outcomes for engineers/PMs). Will paste samples.
Diego R: I can assemble the influencer list (3 ML infra folks, 2 infra-focused newsletters). Want us to DM or email PR contacts?
Ravi M: Start with DM on X for quick asks, email for newsletter placements. Keep asks light: share a stat + webinar link.
Tess L: Copy drafts below. Short headline + 1-line body + CTA.
```
X short (technical):
2.7x p99 token throughput vs baseline. New Redwood benchmark digs into real traces and latency tails. Read the methodology + register for our webinar: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=bench_launch

X short (product):
Benchmarks that matter: 2.7x p99 throughput — see how Redwood reduces inference cost without sacrificing latency. Live demo Wed — register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=bench_launch

LinkedIn (blurb):
New benchmark: Redwood Inference achieves 2.7x token throughput at p99 vs baseline. Join our webinar to explore methodology, demos, and migration tips for production teams. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=bench_launch
```
Claire H: I trimmed them for character limits and added CTAs on the webinar page for "Join webinar" and "Get a demo". Also created UTM matrix (shared in the doc).
growth-bot: Paid budget recommendation generated: organic push + $4k LinkedIn, $1.5k X for a 10-day window; expected leads: 120-180 (mid funnel).
Diego R: DM copy for influencers drafted. Short, polite, includes a one-click reg link and suggested highlight.
Ravi M: Scheduler — we want: X thread (hero image + 4 tweets) Wed 08:30 PT, LinkedIn post Wed 09:30 PT, reminder push day before Wed 08:00 PT. Paid starts Thu 00:00 PT. social-scheduler-bot, can you stage?
social-scheduler-bot: Schedule draft created. Use /schedule <ts> --confirm to lock.
Tess L: Tone test plan: run A/B on X — variant A (technical) vs B (product). Run each for 24hrs organic, measure impressions, CTR to webinar, and replies asking for demo. We'll pick winner to amplify with paid spend.
Claire H: Assets: Diego, please give me high-res model-output screenshot + export sizes: X thread hero 1600x900, LinkedIn 1200x675, square for carousel 1080x1080. I'm on Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/bench-launch
Diego R: Files uploaded to Figma + added alt text. Filenames: bench_hero_1600x900.png, bench_output_snap.png, bench_linkedin_1200x675.png.
Ravi M: Lead routing: Growth owns utm to SFDC mapping. Claire, send final utm strings. Alex from Growth will route to AE rotation.
Claire H: Final UTMs: ?utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_source={platform}&utm_medium=social&utm_content={post_variant}
Alex B: Confirmed. SFDC campaign "Bench Launch Mar26" created. Leads will land in queue "Inbound: Bench Launch". I added workflow to tag source platform and variant if UTM present.
Tess L: Engagement playbook (first 48h): 1) Growth replies to comments with CTA + reg link for demo requests. 2) AEs get high intent leads (demo interest) via SFDC task + slack ping. 3) For technical questions, route to eng-advocates channel and offer follow-up tech doc. I'll write canned replies.
Ravi M: Please include 3 canned replies: demo request, pricing, and migration/scale question. Keep them short.
Tess L: Drafts ready — I'll drop them in the shared doc and tag Growth.
growth-bot: Test lead created: name=Test Lead, email=test+bench@redwood.ai, utm_campaign=bench_launch — routed to SFDC queue.
Alex B: Received test lead, routing good.
Ravi M: Last item — measurement: KRs for the campaign: 1) 150 webinar regs, 2) 100 MQLs in SFDC, 3) CTR > 1.2% on paid. Claire, Diego, confirm you can deliver assets + alt text by EOD Tue.
Claire H: Confirmed.
Diego R: Confirmed.
Ravi M: Thanks everyone. Reconvene Tue 2pm PT for final go/no-go. :rocket:
